title: quercus palustris f. nuttallii
intro: Quercus palustris f. nuttallii, commonly known as Pin Oak, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Fagaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health.
